seriesIds.towl: The Walking Dead: The Ones Who Live

confidenceScale.high: Stated directly by Wikipedia (episode summaries / season articles) or on-screen title cards reported there.
confidenceScale.medium: Ordering from Fandom wiki timelines consistent with Wikipedia, but not officially dated.
confidenceScale.approximate: Fan guess, conflicting sources, or not yet aired.

anchors.claim: Fear S1–S3 serve as a prequel (start of the outbreak); from S4 the series runs concurrently with TWD.

Task brief anchor 'Fear S1–S3 runs concurrently with TWD S1–S4' is NOT supported: Fandom places all of Fear S1–S3 in the outbreak year (2010 fan-dating), alongside Rick's coma / TWD S1–S2, not TWD S3–S4.
Fear S4E01: Morgan leaves his Virginia community (urged to stay by Rick) and reaches Texas – after TWD S8.
TWD S9 contains two jumps: ~1.5 years after S8 at the premiere (Tom Payne quote), and 'six years later' after Rick's helicopter exit in S9E05.
World Beyond is set ten years after the apocalypse began.
Fear S8 takes place seven years after S7 (skip occurs in S8E01).
TWD S11 finale ends with a 'year later' epilogue; Daryl sets out to find Rick.
TOWL is set after TWD's conclusion with backstory covering the years since TWD S9E05.
Daryl Dixon and Dead City are set after the original series' conclusion.

phases.summaryPt: Os primeiros dias e meses do surto: Los Angeles/México (Fear S1–S3) e Geórgia (TWD S1–S2).

items.note: 'Blair/Gina' – Fandom places it on outbreak Day 3 (2010).
Fandom puts all of Fear S3 in 2010; Wikipedia only says S1–S3 'serve as a prequel'.
'La Doña' – Fandom explicitly says its placement is unknown and its slot is a guess.

phases.interleaveNote: Fear S1 begins at the very start of the outbreak, while Rick is in his coma (TWD S1E01 opens weeks in). Fandom lists Fear S1–S3 entirely before TWD S1E01, but in reality their days overlap with Rick's coma and TWD S1–S2; a strict day-level interleave is not stated by any source.

phases.summaryPt: Prisão, Woodbury, Terminus e a estrada até a Virgínia.

items.note: 'Evie/Joe' – Fandom Tales timeline: ~Day 404–459 (late 2011, fan-estimated), between TWD S3 and S4.

phases.summaryPt: Alexandria, Hilltop, Reino e a guerra contra os Salvadores.

items.note: Spans the whole apocalypse up to after TWD S8; watch here.

phases.summaryPt: Morgan deixa a Virgínia e encontra o grupo de Fear no Texas; TWD salta ~1,5 ano após a S8.

items.note: Present-day storyline starts after TWD S8 (Morgan leaves Virginia). Split timeline: S4A flashbacks cover the group's time between Fear S3 and S4 (Fandom dates both ~2012).
'Dee' – Fandom: steamboat period ~2012–2013, before the Whisperers era in TWD.
Opens ~1.5 years after TWD S8 (Tom Payne, cited on Wikipedia S9 page). Fandom orders Fear S4–S5 before TWD S9E01–05; the relative order of Fear S5 vs TWD S9A is fan-derived.

phases.summaryPt: O salto de seis anos de TWD (após S9E05). Fear S6–S7 e World Beyond acontecem nesse intervalo.

items.note: 'Amy/Dr. Everett' – Fandom: Everett has spent ten years isolated, i.e. ~year 10 (2020 fan-estimate).
Wikipedia: set ten years after the apocalypse.

phases.interleaveNote: Rick's CRM backstory (shown in TOWL flashbacks) also unfolds during these years. Fandom places Fear S6–S7 around fan-year 2014 and WB in 2020 before TWD S9E06.

phases.summaryPt: Seis anos depois: Judith, os Sussurradores e a guerra com Alpha.

items.note: S9E06 opens 'six years later' (Wikipedia).

phases.summaryPt: Ceifadores, Commonwealth e o fim de TWD; Fear chega ao fim após seu salto de sete anos.

items.note: S8E01 jumps 'seven years' after Fear S7 (Wikipedia). Fandom slots all of Fear S8 between TWD S11E12 and S11E13; that interleave is fan-derived. Fear S8E09 'Sanctuary' revisits Virginia.
Finale contains a 'one year later' epilogue that launches Daryl's and Rick/Michonne's spin-offs.

phases.summaryPt: Os spin-offs pós-TWD: Rick e Michonne, Daryl na Europa, Maggie e Negan em Manhattan.

items.note: Wikipedia: set after the conclusion of TWD. E1–E3 carry backstory spanning the gap since TWD S9E05 ('five years since being taken'; 'six years after Rick's supposed death').
Begins after Daryl leaves the Commonwealth in the TWD S11 epilogue (Wikipedia cast notes; Fandom).
Final season, 8 episodes, set for February 2027 – NOT YET AIRED.
'Davon' – Fandom places it in fan-year 2025; no official dating found.
Years after TWD's finale; length of gap disputed (see disagreements).
Opens 'a year' after Maggie's return from New York (Wikipedia S2E01 summary).
S3E01 picks up directly from S2's ending (Wikipedia summary; Fandom DC timeline 2028 block).

phases.interleaveNote: TOWL, Daryl Dixon and Dead City run largely in parallel after the TWD finale; Fandom's list orders them TOWL → Daryl Dixon → Tales 'Davon' → Dead City, but no official source fixes their relative order.

disagreements.topic: Dead City gap after TWD finale

positions.claim: Two years after the series finale (SYFY, from Jeffrey Dean Morgan's comments).
Fandom dates S1 to 'June 2027' (~5 years after its 2022 dating of TWD S11), but the same page's day count (Day 6,875 from 2010-08-25) would fall in mid-2029 – internally inconsistent.

disagreements.recommendation: Say 'some years after the TWD finale' without a number.
Compatible – place at end of Fear S2.

positions.claim: Mostly before Fear S4; finale between Fear S5E08 and S5E09.
Listed as a block between Fear S5E08 and S5E09.

disagreements.recommendation: Watch between Fear S5E08 and S5E09.

positions.claim: During Fear S1; prequel to Fear S6.

disagreements.recommendation: Chronologically after Fear S1; optionally offer 'watch before Fear S6'.

positions.claim: All of Fear S8 between TWD S11E12 and S11E13.

disagreements.recommendation: Treat as approximate; no official source.

positions.claim: Placement unknown; slot in 2010 is a guess.
